render_rays_chunked: render rays through a tensorf model in chunks to produce RGB, depth, and blending maps
sample_rays_along_volume: sample 3D points along camera rays for NDC, contracted, or standard ray types
compute_raw2outputs: transform raw model predictions into RGB maps, depth maps, and accumulation weights
run_evaluation_pipeline: evaluate a NeRF model on test poses and compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics
induce_optical_flow: induce optical flow between frames by projecting 3D points to a neighbor camera view
